subject: Film & Cinema
title: Why Animation Matters
description: A micro-lesson that makes Why Animation Matters usable.

hook.text: Animation can show anything. A feeling, a universe, a memory. Live action has limits. Animation doesn't.

buildup.text: From Fantasia to Spider-Verse, animation explores ideas impossible in any other medium.

discovery.text: It's the only art form where every single element — every pixel, line, and color — is intentional.

twist.text: Yet animation is still undervalued — 'it's just cartoons' persists as a dismissal.

climax.text: Animation's future is limitless because imagination's future is limitless.

punchline.text: If you can imagine it, animation can show it.

quiz.question: Why is animation unique among art forms?
options: Every single visual element is intentionally created by the artist
